mods.name: Battle: Tank Warfare
mods.description: Pick TANKS on the main menu: everyone commands a tank on Iron Steppe, a wide open map.

mods.name: Battle: Aviation
mods.description: Pick AVIATION on the main menu: everyone flies jets and bombers. Three 3 km maps (Highlands, Dune Sea, Fjordland), three modes (sky-zone Conquest, Air Superiority, Ground Strike) and C-RAM guns guarding every airbase.

mods.name: Battle: Naval
mods.description: Pick NAVAL on the main menu: battleships, cruisers, destroyers, frigates, corvettes and patrol boats with fires, flooding, damage control and Phalanx CIWS. Three seas (Sapphire Strait, Iron Harbor, Arctic Passage), three modes (Conquest, Fleet Battle, Strike).

mods.name: Multiplayer
mods.description: Public online play: host a game, share the 4-letter code, and anyone with the game can join and pick a side.

mods.name: Jets
mods.description: F-16C, F/A-18E, A-10C, F-15E, F-35A and F-22A against MiG-29, Su-27, Su-25, Su-34, Su-35S and Su-57. Stealth, radar missiles, guided bombs, flares, eject.

mods.name: Bombers
mods.description: B-17, B-52H, B-1B and B-2A against Lancaster, Tu-95MS, Tu-22M3 and Tu-160: bomb bays, cruise missiles, swing wings and gun turrets you can man.

mods.name: Armory
mods.description: Built in and always on: the gun attachments (suppressors, barrels, grips, magazines, lasers, ammunition, finishes) that change real stats and show on the gun in your hands. They are researched, bought and equipped in the RESEARCH screen.

mods.name: Career
mods.description: Built in and always on: War Thunder Mobile style research trees for ships, aircraft, tanks and guns (RESEARCH on the main menu). Winning battles pays research points, silver and gold; research, buy, put vehicles in your crew slots and fit modifications and gun attachments. Only your crew goes into battle, and you always use your own vehicle.

mods.name: Helicopters
mods.description: Built in and always on: AH-1Z Viper and AH-64E Apache against the Mi-24V Hind and Ka-52 Alligator, flying ground support in NORMAL, TANK and AVIATION battles. Chin guns that follow your sight, guided anti-tank missiles, rockets, and GROUND SUPPORT MISSIONS that cost the enemy tickets.

mods.name: Vehicle Interiors
mods.description: Press C to sit inside tanks, jet cockpits, bomber flight decks and helicopter cockpits.

mods.name: Random Wheel
mods.description: Spins a random map and a random game mode before every match.

mods.name: Mode: Capture the Flag
mods.description: Steal the enemy flag and bring it home. First to 3. Restarts the game.

mods.name: Mode: King of the Hill
mods.description: One big point in the middle. Hold it to win. Restarts the game.

mods.name: HD Weapons
mods.description: Detailed 3D models for every gun, flying brass, barrel smoke, reflections.

mods.name: Aggressive Reloads
mods.description: 35% faster reloads that slam, flick and kick.

mods.name: HD Knife
mods.description: A real gloved hand holding a detailed combat knife, with slash, backhand and stab animations.

mods.name: Mode: Gun Game
mods.description: Every kill upgrades your gun. First pistol kill wins. Restarts the game.

mods.name: Mode: Hardpoint
mods.description: One capture point that moves every 60 seconds, on any map. Restarts the game.

mods.name: Mode: Last Stand
mods.description: Survive 10 waves of raiders. Restarts the game.

mods.name: Map: Dust Ridge
mods.description: Desert bazaar, walled compounds, dunes. Restarts the game.

mods.name: Map: Iron Forest
mods.description: Dense misty woods, sawmill, ranger tower. Restarts the game.

mods.name: Map: Old Town
mods.description: Street fighting across a whole city grid. Restarts the game.

mods.name: Heavy Arsenal
mods.description: Pump shotgun, SCAR-H with its own 3D model, Breacher class.

mods.name: Commander Call-ins
mods.description: Airstrikes (T) and reinforcement squads (Y). The enemy strikes back.

mods.name: Jetpack
mods.description: Hold J to fly. Fuel refills on the ground.

mods.name: Explosive Rounds
mods.description: B toggles high-explosive bullets that burst on impact.

mods.name: Bullet Time
mods.description: Headshot kills slow the battle down for a moment.

mods.name: Map: Karsa Outskirts
mods.description: A new battlefield with four flags. Restarts the game.

mods.name: Team Deathmatch
mods.description: No flags, 120 tickets each. Restarts the game.

mods.name: Night Ops
mods.description: Night battle under the stars, green tracers, renamed armies.

mods.name: Moon Gravity
mods.description: Low gravity, huge jumps, bigger explosions.

mods.name: Hardcore
mods.description: 60 health, no regeneration, deadlier headshots, tougher tanks.

mods.name: Vampire Rounds
mods.description: Script mod: kills heal you and streaks pay out.
